#!/bin/bash
# monitor_pid1.sh - Monitor PID 1 (cluster-api-server.py)
# Checks whether the target process is still running and logs the result.

TARGET_PID=1
PROCESS_NAME="cluster-api-server.py"
LOG_FILE="/root/.openclaw/workspace/monitor_pid1.log"
TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')

if kill -0 "$TARGET_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    STATUS="OK"
    MESSAGE="[$TIMESTAMP] [OK] PID $TARGET_PID ($PROCESS_NAME) is running."
else

    MESSAGE="[$TIMESTAMP] [ALERT] PID $TARGET_PID ($PROCESS_NAME) is NOT running!"
fi

echo "$MESSAGE" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
exit $([ "$STATUS" = "OK" ] && echo 0 || echo 1)

#!/bin/bash
# monitor_pid1.sh - Monitor PID 1 (cluster-api-server.py)
# Checks whether the target process is still running.
# If not found, restarts the diagnostic script automatically.

TARGET_PID=1
PROCESS_NAME="cluster-api-server.py"
SCRIPT_PATH="/app/cluster-api-server.py"
LOG_FILE="/root/.openclaw/workspace/monitor_pid1.log"
TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')

log() {
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] $1" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

if kill -0 "$TARGET_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    log "[OK] PID $TARGET_PID ($PROCESS_NAME) is running."
    exit 0
else
    log "[ALERT] PID $TARGET_PID ($PROCESS_NAME) is NOT running. Attempting restart..."

    if [ ! -f "$SCRIPT_PATH" ]; then
        log "[ERROR] Script not found at $SCRIPT_PATH — cannot restart."
        exit 2
    fi

    # Restart the diagnostic script in the background
    nohup python3 "$SCRIPT_PATH" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 &
    NEW_PID=$!

    # Brief pause to confirm it started
    sleep 2
    if kill -0 "$NEW_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        log "[RESTARTED] $PROCESS_NAME restarted successfully with new PID $NEW_PID."
        exit 0
    else
        log "[ERROR] Restart attempted but $PROCESS_NAME (PID $NEW_PID) failed to stay alive."
        exit 1
    fi
fi
